title: Increase Default Zoom for Concrete Forest Fixture
description: The concrete forest 5d fixture has zoom=1 for both 2d and 3d cameras, which makes the model appear too small by default. Increase the 2d zoom and increase the 3d zoom even more so the model is properly visible at startup.
summary: Updated default zoom for the concrete forest fixture across all three fixture files (2d, 3d, 5d). For 2D: zoom increased from 1 to 2 and camera position centered on the single part at (230.73, 93.53). For 3D: zoom increased from 1 to 3 (higher than 2D as requested).
